name: KAISER 5 E

specs.notes: The 3.8 S38B38 straight six (individual throttle bodies): 340 PS (250 kW) at 6,900 rpm and 400 Nm at 4,750 rpm. The six-speed's ratios (fitted from spring 1994), the 3.23 final drive and the 25 % limited-slip differential are from auto motor und sport's technical data. Weights differ by source: 1,650 kg German empty weight, 1,711-1,725 kg UK figures (5- and 6-speed); the game uses 1,725 kg, the UK figure for the 6-speed. 250 km/h limited (Autozeitung measured 256). No official weight distribution or drag figure was found: 52 % front and Cd 0.32 on 2.05 m^2 are estimates.

garage.blurb: The last hand-built M5: a four-door saloon with a racing straight six, individual throttles and a six-speed manual. A gentleman's express that howls to 7,000.

interior.notes: The model's: dash, leather seats, its wheel (cut out by material) and gear lever (the knob on its boot, cut out by box); left-hand drive; a six-speed H gate.
